nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Environment variable template for the client app, documenting the required VITE_GATEWAY_URL and optional Stripe publishable key and admin origin overrides for the unified Vite+Express server on port 4000.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Root HTML entry point for the Cosmos SPA, including a theme initialization inline script that reads the 'cosmos.theme' key from localStorage and applies the 'obsidian' or 'aurora' data-theme attribute before first paint to prevent flash of wrong theme.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains an inline blocking script for early theme injection, a common pattern to prevent FOUC (Flash of Unstyled Content) with multi-theme apps.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the @cosmos/client workspace, defining scripts for dev, build, test, and lint alongside a rich dependency set including React 19, TanStack Query/Table, react-router-dom, Zustand, Zod, Stripe, DnD Kit, Recharts, and Tailwind CSS.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the client app source, enabling strict mode, bundler module resolution, react-jsx transform, and a path alias mapping '@/*' to './src/*' for clean imports.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: Separate TypeScript configuration scoped to vite.config.ts, targeting ES2022 with bundler module resolution for type-checking Vite configuration files outside the main app source tree.
